buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ​​The Seller is requested to submit/upload only the documents specifically asked for in the Bid, such as the r equired certificates and other documents mentioned therein. No additional or unrelated documents should be submitted/uploaded. BUYER ADDED BID SPECIFIC ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) 1.Mandatory Letterhead Submission: All undertakings, declarations, and certificates submitted by the bidd er must be strictly printed/typed on the Official Company Letterhead of the Bidder with the proper date, Ge M Bid Number, and the clear signature and seal/stamp of the Authorized Signatory. 2.Rejection Rule: Any undertaking or document uploaded on a plain paper, blank white sheet, or without th e company's official letterhead, sign, and stamp shall be summarily REJECTED without any further clarification or opportunity during the Technical Evaluation stage. 3. The Service Provider (Seller) shall be solely and entirely responsible for the planning, coordination, man agement, and execution of the complete multi-location package tour. The entire tour shall be conducted st rictly in accordance with the itinerary, travel route, schedule, and other specified requirements as detailed in the Tour Programme uploaded on ATC. 4.The bid price shall be all-inclusive and cover all expenses associated with the execution of the entire tou r, including but not limited to flight tickets, 2AC train tickets, AC bus/taxi transportation and logistics, acco mmodation in 3-star hotels, all meals (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner), packaged mineral water, and 100% of the entry tickets/fees for all sightseeing monuments and places mentioned in the Tour Programme upload ed on ATC. No additional payment shall be admissible on account of any of the above-mentioned expenses. No Out-of-Pocket Expenses: No passenger shall be asked to pay any extra amount during the to ur for toll taxes, state permits, driver allowances, or entry tickets. Mandatory Certificates for Technical Eligibility

5. Bidders must scan and upload the following certificates in PDF format. Failure to upload any of these do cuments will result in immediate rejection in the Technical Evaluation round: 6. CA Certified Turnover Certificate: A certificate on the Chartered Accountant's official letterhead stating t he seller's annual turnover from tour and travel services for the last 3 financial years. It must contain a vali d UDIN number. 7.Past Performance/Experience Certificate: Work Completion Certificates signed by a competent authority of a Government Department, PSU, or Autonomous Body, proving successful execution of similar compreh ensive tour packages (Flight + Train + Bus combined). Note: Only Purchase Orders without a Completion C ertificate will be rejected. 8.Non-Blacklisting Undertaking: An affidavit or declaration on the Seller's Official Company Letterhead (sig ned and stamped) confirming that the firm has never been blacklisted, banned, or suspended by the GeM portal, any Central/State Government body, or PSU. 9.No Sub-Contracting / Direct Execution Undertaking: A formal undertaking on the Seller's Official Compan y Letterhead guaranteeing that they will execute the entire multi-location tour directly using their own infr astructure and will NOT outsource or sub-let the work to any third-party local operators. 10.Statutory Registrations: Valid GSTIN Registration Certificate, Company PAN Card, and Ministry of Touris m Approval or IATA Membership Certificate. Flight & Train Booking Standards. 11. Flight Bookings: All flight tickets must be booked on reputed mainline carriers with confirmed status. L ow-cost unbundled basic fares that exclude check-in baggage are strictly prohibited. Tickets must include a minimum of 15 kg check-in luggage and 7 kg hand baggage per passenger. 12. Train Travel (Strictly AC 2-Tier – 2AC): The service provider shall arrange train travel exclusively in AC 2-Tier (2AC) class. Booking in any class lower than 2AC, including AC 3-Tier (3AC), Sleeper Class, Second S eating (2S), or any other lower category, shall be strictly prohibited. 13.Confirmed Tickets Only: All train tickets must have a Confirmed Status at least 48 hours before the jour ney. No passenger shall be made to travel on Waiting List (WL) or Reservation Against Cancellation (RAC) tickets. Premium Road Transport (Bus & Taxi Standards) 14.Vehicle Condition: All local transfers and sightseeing must be conducted using premium AC Buses or AC Taxis (like Innova, Ertiga, or equivalent commercial vehicles). 15.Safety & Compliance: All vehicles must possess valid commercial registration, fitness certificates, comp rehensive insurance, and active state tourist permits. Drivers must be professional, uniformed, verified, an d well-behaved. Premium Accommodation (Strictly 3-Star & Above) 16.Hotel Standard: Hotel accommodations at all destinations must be strictly 3-Star or higher category, ap proved by the Ministry of Tourism or reputed booking platforms. 17.Amenities: Rooms must be well-ventilated, fully air-conditioned, hygienic, equipped with neat linen, att ached clean bathrooms with 24/7 hot water. 18.Room Allocation Room allocation shall be strictly on a Single Occupancy or Double Occupancy basis, as specified in the Tour Programme uploaded on ATC. The Service Provider (Seller) shall ensure compliance

with the prescribed room occupancy requirements throughout the tour. Strict Ticket Cancellation & Modification Policy 19. Seller's Responsibility: If a ticket (Flight/Train) is cancelled or missed due to any delay, mismanagemen t, or negligence caused by the Service Provider, the Seller shall re-book a confirmed ticket in the same or h igher class immediately at their own expense. 20. Emergency Cancellation: If a passenger cancels their journey due to an official emergency before ticke t generation, the Seller must pass on the actual airline/railway refund to the Buyer department without ad ding any administrative processing fees. Penalty Clauses for Service Failures. 21. Ticket Failure Penalty: If the Seller fails to provide confirmed 2AC train tickets or confirmed flight ticket s as specified in the Tour Programme uploaded on ATC, or provides tickets in a lower class or waiting-list s tatus without prior written approval of the Buyer, the Seller shall be solely responsible for arranging altern ative confirmed tickets in the same or higher class at no additional cost to the Buyer. Any additional expen ses arising from such failure shall be borne entirely by the Seller. Further, appropriate penalties/liquidated damages shall be imposed and deducted from the Seller's final bill as per the penalty provisions specified i n the tender, subject to applicable Government procurement rules. 22.Substandard Hotel: If the Seller provides accommodation in a hotel below the 3-Star category, a pen alty shall be imposed in accordance with the applicable rules and regulations of the Department. 23.Outsourcing/Sub-Letting Ban: If the Seller is found to have outsourced or sub-contracted the tour mana gement to a local cheap operator without prior written approval, the contract will be terminated instantly, the performance security will be forfeited, and debarment/blacklisting procedures will be initiated on GeM. Post-Tour Payment Terms 24.Zero Advance: No advance payment shall be released to the Service Provider under any circumstances 25.Payment Terms: Payment shall be made only after the successful completion of the tour. In the event of non-conduct of the tour due to flight cancellation or any other reason for which the 7th Battalion (7th Bn) i s not responsible, no payment shall be made to the Seller. 26. Insurance: - The entire trip and travelers will be covered by insurance with respect to flight cancellatio n medical emergency and treatment, accident and the bidders will bear the cost of premium for insurance 27.The pick-up and drop-off point for the entire tour shall be 7th Battalion, SSB, Channi Himmat, Jammu. 28.Submission of Travel Documents: The Seller shall submit scanned copies of all confirmed flight/train tic kets, clearly displaying the valid PNR numbers, passenger details, travel dates, and other relevant booking information, along with copies of valid insurance policies covering all travellers, to the Buyer Department t hrough official email at least 48 hours prior to the commencement of the tour. The Seller shall ensure that all submitted documents are genuine, complete, valid, and in accordance with the approved Tour Program me. 29.The seller shall submit a duly signed undertaking com acceptance certificate confirming that the seller has carefully read understood and unconditionally accepted the entire Scope of work, terms & Conditions a ll applicable requirements and the complete tour programme specified uploaded by the buyer in the ATC d

ocument and agrees to comply with all the same without any deviation. 30.Financial Price Break-up Requirement: Bidders must upload a detailed financial document indicating the itemized price break-up along with their financial bid. The break-up must clearly show the per-head or per- day cost for Accommodation (Hotels), Transport (Vehicles), Fooding, and Administrative/Service charges. T he total of this break-up must exactly match the total lump-sum price quoted on the GeM portal. 31.Vendor’s Financial Responsibility for Ticketing: The successful bidder (Seller) shall be solely responsible for executing all air/train ticket bookings as per the itinerary. Any variation, escalation, or dynamic pricing fluctuations in the ticket fares during the contract period shall be entirely borne by the Seller. The Buyer w ill not entertain any claims for extra payment due to ticket price increases under any circumstances. . 4.
